# Acme Widgets

> Documentation for the Acme Widgets API and SDKs. The index follows the Mintlify-style shape: one H2 group per docs area, one `.md` link per page.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.acme.dev/introduction.md): What Acme Widgets does and who it is for
- [Quickstart](https://docs.acme.dev/quickstart.md): Install the SDK and make a first API call

## API Reference

- [Authentication](https://docs.acme.dev/api-reference/authentication.md): API keys and scopes
- [Pagination](https://docs.acme.dev/api-reference/pagination.md): Cursor pagination over list endpoints
